items.summary: Brand Information: Thom Browne is a New York-based global fashion house best known for its iconic 4-Bar stripes and monochromatic palettes. Deeply rooted in luxury tailored suits, Thom Browne redefines modern tailoring with distinctive structures and fits with its ankle-length trousers, narrow lapel collars, and fitted silhouettes. The label carries collections for men, women, and children alike providing a contemporary American uniform look for all generations. items.title: New Arrivals From HBX: Lemaire
items.summary: Brand Information: In an age of ever-changing trends, a timeless garment speaks volumes, and one of the leading voices in contemporary fashion will be Lemaire, a French-based fashion label. Helmed by Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran, the label is an expert in refining the classic Parisian style with supple silhouettes, grounded palettes, and utility elements borrowed from traditional Asian clothing. items.title: lululemon’s Clean-Cut Outerwear Collection Arrives at Zalando
items.summary: Just in time for the new season, sportswear label lululemon brings its technically built outerwear to Zalando. The latest collection applies the label’s refined blueprint to functional styles, giving coats and jackets a versatile edge for everyday wear. With puffer jackets often adopting large silhouettes, lululemon provides a unique alternative through an array of sleeker shapes. Helping to achieve this aesthetic, the label incorporates innovative insulating materials to keep silhouettes tailored while ensuring warmth and weatherproofing.
